architecture.rule: Do not apply Onion Architecture or Clean Architecture to Django projects unless the project explicitly overrides this rule.

viewsets.rule: ViewSets should validate requests and call services.
ViewSets should contain no business logic.

models.rule: Each domain database model should have its own Django app when the domain is sufficiently independent.

managers.rule: Use custom Django managers to encapsulate common and core database queries and table-level pre-filtering operations.

settings.rule: Split Django settings into multiple files.
Maintain separate development, production, and test settings.
Use a base settings layer for settings shared by multiple environments.

django_structure.rule: The following is the recommended Django structure when the Django technology profile is active.
django_structure.structure:
apps/ accounts/ customers/ dashboard/ documents/ passports/ payments/ tickets/ visas/
common/ exceptions.py mixins/ models/ pagination.py permissions/ utils/
config/ asgi.py celery.py settings/ urls.py wsgi.py
docs/

requirements/ base.txt dev.txt prod.txt
tests/ accounts/ customers/ dashboard/ factories.py passports/ payments/ tickets/ visas/
